answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 5 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the fable release is entered with every signature, the nebula audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the jade graph and each risks its bond. A farm of 273 pays that 44 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
